title: Parley — Accept Response
description: Response body for POST /api/pact/parleys/{id}/accept (§19.3.2). Added in PACT v2.1 (§19).

join_token.description: The accepting side's agent credential (§19.3.3): ≥128-bit CSPRNG, bound to this parley_id and the accepted Mandate's agent_id, single-use for join, then presented on in-Parley operations.

mandate_digest.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 §20.3 digest of the accepted Mandate.

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisories, including §19.3.2 mandate-intersection deadlock warnings (ratified Q2).
